recorded: Three anyps5-retro-host processes built locally (WinLibs GCC 15.2, Windows x64, Release) from B-Howell/anyps5-retro-host netplay-design ce13e07, running SwanStation 631f0fb with the host's five SwanStation patches (cores/apply-swanstation-patches.sh) on OpenBIOS and the psyqo hello disc, both built as the host repository's real-core workflow builds them (nugget 875bfcb). They were driven by that repository's tests/rollback_test.py, its first phase, for 180 frames: a reference in plain lockstep given every frame's input, and two players' hosts in rollback (window 8), each knowing its own port at once and the other's 1 to 6 frames late with jitter, stepping it null and correcting it when it came. 'players' holds, for each player's host in the order the harness sent and read them, the calls, steps and corrections sent ('sent') and the welcome, replies, syncs and rollback messages the host sent ('got'), as JSON text; 'reference' holds the reference's syncs; 'tick' is the seconds a simulated frame lasted. The paths in start are left out.
